summary.text: Cynthia Ball is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 49 in Wake County since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is House Deputy Democratic Leader, and the General Assembly lists her occupation as mediator.

paragraphs.text: Cynthia Ball assumed office in the North Carolina House on January 1, 2017, succeeding Gary Pendleton (R).
The General Assembly lists five terms in the House for Ball, along with her leadership role as House Deputy Democratic Leader.
The Democratic primary scheduled for March 3, 2026, was canceled.
